mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.agent_id AS agentId, p.tool_id AS toolId, t.tool_code AS toolCode, t.tool_name AS toolName, t.risk_level AS riskLevel, p.timeout_seconds AS timeoutSeconds, p.daily_limit AS dailyLimit, p.enabled FROM agent_tool_permission p JOIN managed_tool t ON p.tool_id = t.id WHERE p.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY t.tool_name

SELECT p.id, p.agent_id AS agentId, p.resource_type AS resourceType, p.resource_id AS resourceId, p.access_level AS accessLevel, p.enabled, COALESCE(h.host_name, a.app_name, d.instance_name) AS resourceName, COALESCE(h.environment, d.environment, '-') AS resourceEnvironment FROM agent_resource_permission p LEFT JOIN managed_host h ON p.resource_type = 'HOST' AND p.resource_id = h.id LEFT JOIN managed_application a ON p.resource_type = 'APPLICATION' AND p.resource_id = a.id LEFT JOIN managed_database d ON p.resource_type = 'DATABASE' AND p.resource_id = d.id WHERE p.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY p.resource_type, resourceName

SELECT id, agent_id AS agentId, auto_approve_max_risk AS autoApproveMaxRisk, production_requires_approval AS productionRequiresApproval, high_risk_requires_approval AS highRiskRequiresApproval, credential_access_enabled AS credentialAccessEnabled FROM agent_approval_policy WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_tool_permission(id, agent_id, tool_id, timeout_seconds, daily_limit, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{agentId}, #{toolId}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{dailyLimit}, #{enabled}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO agent_resource_permission(id, agent_id, resource_type, resource_id, access_level, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{agentId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{accessLevel}, #{enabled}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO agent_approval_policy(id, agent_id, auto_approve_max_risk, production_requires_approval, high_risk_requires_approval, credential_access_enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{agentId}, #{autoApproveMaxRisk}, #{productionRequiresApproval}, #{highRiskRequiresApproval}, #{credentialAccessEnabled}, #{now}, #{now})
